name: Percentage_Crossover_Channel_EA
summary: This EA trades based on a percentage-based channel that dynamically adjusts to price movements. It enters buy positions when price crosses below the lower channel boundary and sell positions when price crosses above the upper channel boundary, aiming to capture mean reversion moves within the channel range.
summary_zh: 该EA基于百分比通道进行交易，通道根据价格动态调整。当价格穿越通道下边界时做多，穿越上边界时做空，旨在捕捉通道范围内的均值回归行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于百分比计算的动态通道，通道上下轨根据价格的一定百分比偏移量构建，形成类似布林带的包络线。入场条件为：当价格从上方穿越下通道时开多单，预期价格回归通道中心；当价格从下方穿越上通道时开空单，预期价格回落。出场条件依赖通道交叉信号的反转，即持仓至价格穿越对侧通道边界时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数参数，未发现基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理上缺乏明确的最大持仓限制和最大回撤控制，整体依赖通道回归假设但未设置硬性止损保护。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能因价格持续偏离通道而产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is a dynamically calculated percentage-based channel, where the upper and lower boundaries are constructed as a percentage offset from price, forming an envelope similar to Bollinger Bands. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when price crosses below the lower channel boundary, expecting mean reversion toward the channel center; open a sell position when price crosses above the upper channel boundary, expecting price to fall back. Exit conditions rely on the reversal of the crossover signal — positions are held until price crosses the opposite channel boundary. Position sizing uses a fixed lot parameter with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks explicit maximum position limits and drawdown controls, relying on channel mean reversion assumptions without hard stop-loss protection. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but may suffer consecutive losses in strong trending conditions where price persistently deviates from the channel.

pros: 百分比通道动态适应价格变化，比固定区间更具灵活性
策略逻辑简洁清晰，参数少易于理解和优化
均值回归逻辑在震荡市中具有统计学优势
pros_en: Percentage-based channel dynamically adapts to price changes, offering more flexibility than fixed ranges
Simple and clear strategy logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
Mean reversion logic has statistical edge in ranging markets
cons: 缺乏硬性止损，强趋势行情中可能造成严重亏损
固定手数仓位管理无法根据市场波动率自适应调整
未实现新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks hard stop-loss, which can cause severe losses in strong trending markets
Fixed lot position sizing cannot adapt to market volatility changes
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损和止盈机制，提高风险控制能力
实现新K线检测逻辑，避免同一根K线上重复信号开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanism to improve risk control
Implement new bar detection logic to prevent duplicate signal entries on the same bar

risk_points: 缺乏硬性止损保护，强趋势中亏损可能无限扩大
无新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定手数不考虑账户净值变化，极端行情下杠杆风险不可控
risk_points_en: No hard stop-loss protection, losses can expand indefinitely in strong trends
No new bar check may cause duplicate position openings on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
Fixed lot size ignores account equity changes, making leverage risk uncontrollable in extreme markets
